test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Viceroys of British India took the first step to separate provincial finance from central finance and introduced financial decentralisation in India in 1870?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Mayo.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In **1870, Lord Mayo** had taken first place in the direction of dividing **central and provincial finances**.
 
• **Lord Mayo** followed the policy of non-intervention and began the procedure of** decentralization of finance in India in 1870.**
 
• **Lord Mayo** was the **4th Viceroy** of India from 1869 to 1872.
 
• He established **Mayo College in Ajmer** for educating children of Aristocratic families.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord Dufferin** worked as Governor General of India and Viceroy from** 1884 to 1888.**
 
• In the middle of **1872 and 1876**, India's Viceroy was **Lord Northbrook**.
 
• **Lord Chelmsford** worked as **Viceroy and Governor General of India from 1916 to 1921.​ **
